title: write_signing_key temp file name not unique within process
description: crates/core/src/signing.rs: write_signing_key names the temp file using only std::process::id() (the PID). Two concurrent calls in the same process (e.g., during parallel key rotation) would generate the same temp file name, causing one to clobber the other or race on rename. Fix: include a per-call unique component (thread ID + monotonic counter, or use tempfile crate's NamedTempFile) in the temp file name to guarantee uniqueness.
